description: Before an agent signs or sends from a crypto wallet: send the destination address (to), the page that asked (url) and/or the wallet request it is about to approve (request: the EIP-1193 method and params). The address is checked for its chain and checksum, the US Treasury OFAC sanctions list, and pages DechoNet judged dangerous that showed it; the page goes through the phishing link check and the official exchange, wallet and dApp list; the request is read for what approving it would allow (unlimited token approval, approval for a whole NFT collection, Permit/Permit2 signatures, Seaport orders, raw eth_sign, transfers). Verdicts: danger, suspicious, no_signals. no_signals means none of the checks found a warning sign and is not a statement that the transaction is harmless; 'unchecked' lists what was not looked at (balances, token contracts, simulation). Nothing sent is stored. Rate-limited.
